desc: Parse N and S from stdin; collect 0-indexed positions of all '1' characters into list `pos`.
Compute transformed array `q[i] = pos[i] - i` for each i.
Find median of q (element at index K//2 since q is already non-decreasing — pos strictly increasing implies q non-decreasing).
Sum `abs(q[i] - median)` over all i and print as the answer.
Edge-check: K=1 gives 0; already-contiguous input gives 0; confirm against samples mentally (0101001 → 3, 100 → 0, 0101001001 → 7).
Write final Python solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin), O(N) time, O(K) memory; enclose code in required delimiters.
